description: Fixture 01 with debug info stripped (symbols kept), as most shipped firmware is. No DWARF means no buffer sizes; the return-address oracle must still confirm the overflow, and the safe twin cannot be cleared.

cases.reason: mem_copy writes 64 bytes into a 16-byte buffer and runs over vulnerable_copy's saved LR.
The copy is clamped, but with no DWARF an overflow that stops short of the saved registers would be invisible, so the tool must not claim FP.
